summary: Verified all 96 source files and reproduced all five computations. Figure 5b reports 23 semaglutide-versus-vehicle discoveries. The registered edgeR table has zero among 17,727 published symbols at FDR < 0.05. The figure gives no gene identities for those 23 discoveries, so `no_valid_comparison` stands. The corrected proposal passed validation. [Published Figure 5](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC11136670/#Fig5)
openIssues: GEO labels the arm GLP-1. The library identifiers and study design support the link to semaglutide, but the authors’ sample key is needed to confirm individual assignments.
Gene identifiers, signed effects and the author-tested gene set are needed to assess concordance. Raw and adjusted P values would help investigate the separate discovery-count difference.
